context: Asuka lectures on the domestic economy in history.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: economics lecture; vocabulary (最大/国内/予想/収入/上昇) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後、国内の収入は大きく上昇しました。
lines.en: After the war, domestic incomes rose greatly.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最大の理由は、何だったんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最大の理由は、国内産業の成長です。
lines.en: The biggest reason was domestic industry's growth.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 当時、上昇は予想されていたんですか?
lines.en: Was the rise forecast at the time?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 予想を超える上昇に、皆驚きました。
lines.en: Everyone was surprised by the rise beyond forecasts.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 収入が増えて、生活も変わったんですね。
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国内の消費も、大きく上昇しました。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最大の変化の時代だったんですね。
lines.en: It was an era of the greatest change.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
